tool_input.prompt:
Create a dark classic Diablo II inspired PRE-RENDERED GAME SPRITE: dimensional matte material shading, tiny integrated raster clusters, soft colored edges, deep ambient occlusion, restrained iron glints. Render the subject as a compact game piece with volumetric depth and weathered materials, with no ink contour. The structure is a cute squat caricature, never a realistically proportioned warrior.

ONE whole-body knight on a plain charcoal square canvas, subtle floor shadow, no writing. High bird's-eye orthographic game camera looking DOWN from 55 degrees above the ground. The upright barrel helmet's level flat circular lid is a broad deep ellipse, depth about 80% of its width; the top plane dominates, shoulders are mostly hidden beneath it, body and legs foreshortened. He faces diagonally lower-right.

EXAGGERATED CUTE PROPORTIONS: enormous wide helmet, tiny broad belly, very short stubby arms and legs, squat rounded boots. Roughly two head-heights tall before foreshortening. The head is wider than the body.

Wear a dull iron full-face cylindrical greathelm, plain flat crown, two vertical riveted face strips, narrow black visor slit, small breathing holes, no visible eyes or skin. Dark plain ring-mail shirt and short sleeves, ragged dried-wine scarf and short cape, matching ragged waist cloth, brown belt with plain rectangular buckle, brown gloves, taupe-brown forearm and shin wraps, short rounded brown boots. In viewer-left hand hold a straight double-edged arming sword: straight crossguard, disk pommel, straight blade pointing down across the front toward lower-right. Carry an elongated taupe wooden kite shield at viewer-right with dull iron rim and one narrow faded wine-red panel. Keep these exact costume pieces, restrained iron gray, taupe and dried-wine colors. This is a rural household knight from the Royans/Isere lands in a story set in 1101; the full-face greathelm is a deliberately allowed anachronism. No extra plate armor or ornament.
